name.zh: 第二轮倒着选补偿后手
name.en: Reverse the next pass to compensate late picks

summary.zh: 前面先挑，后面则有机会连着挑两次。
summary.en: Early players pick first; late players may pair consecutive picks.

rules.zh: 每人需要选择多次时，第一遍按顺序进行，第二遍反向返回，减少同一人总是先选的优势。玩家不仅看单件价值，也要考虑距离下次选择还有几个人；转折位置可连续选择，适合拿互相配合的两件。
rules.en: For repeated picks, proceed in order and then reverse the next pass. This reduces repeated first access while making the gap until the next pick important. Players at the turn-around can take consecutive picks and secure a pair.

loop.en: Pick again after the order reverses

loop.zh: 根据两次所得形成方案
loop.en: Build a plan from the pair

decisions.zh: 先手拿单件最强，还是拿必须配另一件才有用的部分？
decisions.en: Take the strongest standalone item first or start a combination that needs another piece?

decisions.zh: 最后一位能连选两次，要凑组合还是抢两个通用强项？
decisions.en: Use consecutive picks for a pair or two broadly strong options?

effect.zh: 一次往返便于理解，多轮反转需要持续提示顺序。
effect.en: One out-and-back pass is easy to read; repeated reversals need persistent order cues.

effect.zh: 成对收益越大，连续两次选择就越有价值。
effect.en: Stronger pair rewards make consecutive picks more valuable.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：彩色骰子、公共骰池、彩窗盘面与轮次轨道同屏显示。
observation.en: System reference: Colored dice, a shared dice pool, stained-glass boards and a round track share the screen. See the linked text source for the rules.

implementation.zh: 每轮按玩家顺序各选一次骰子，再从最后一位反向各选一次，所以末位玩家的两次选择相邻。
implementation.en: Each round drafts once in player order and then once in reverse, giving the last player adjacent picks.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：六边形地图上可见道路、村落与资源信息。
observation.en: System reference: Roads, settlements and resource information appear around a hexagonal map. See the linked text source for the rules.

implementation.zh: 标准自由开局放置中，每人先依顺序放第一组定居点和道路，再由末位玩家起反向放第二组；这不是常规回合的行动顺序。
implementation.en: In standard variable setup, players place one settlement-road pair in order, then place the second pair in reverse from the last player; normal turns do not use this order.

contrast.zh: 璀璨玻璃每轮重复往返选骰；卡坦岛将往返主要用于开局选址，之后回到通常的回合顺序。
contrast.en: Sagrada repeats the pattern for each dice draft; Catan primarily uses it for initial placement before normal turn order resumes.

combination.zh: 组合提案：玩家蛇形轮选双用途卡，先手优先保住通用牌，末位则可连续拿到互相支持的生产与行动两张牌。
combination.en: Design proposal: snake-draft dual-use cards, letting early players secure versatile cards while the last player takes a production-and-action pair together.

setup.zh: 三人选六件工具，顺序为甲、乙、丙、丙、乙、甲。
setup.en: Three players draft six tools in the order A, B, C, C, B, A.

action.zh: 丙连续拿走锯子和木工夹。
action.en: C takes a saw and clamp consecutively.

result.zh: 丙凑齐组合，甲最先拿的强工具却没有配件。
result.en: C completes a pair while A’s strong first pick lacks support.

next.zh: 甲最后一次选择要改拿通用工具，或保留未来再补配件的计划。
next.en: A must take a general tool last or plan to find support later.

firstStep.zh: 三名本地玩家、六张工具牌和两种成对奖励，把六次顺序一直显示在屏幕上。
firstStep.en: Use three local players, six tool cards and two pair bonuses with the full order visible.

pitfall.zh: 蛇形顺序只能补偿部分先手差异，不能保证任意奖励结构都公平。
pitfall.en: Snake order offsets some first-pick advantage but cannot balance every reward structure.

test.zh: 先手与末位是否形成不同的拿牌策略，且都能说清原因？
test.en: Do early and late pickers use different strategies and explain why?
